窣 MC *sot is the standard initial s+t cluster (cf. 窣堵波 stūpa), 菟 *thuo gives -thū-, 黎 *lej gives -le-/-lī-, and 濕伐羅 *ɕip-buat-la gives -śvara. 窣菟黎濕伐羅 = sthūleśvara/sthūlīśvara is a very good fit, better than Strīśvara (which has no u) or Sunurīśvara (corrupt 奴).

朅 MC *khjat has velar k- and -a-, and gives Kacch-/Khaj- far more naturally than Koṭi- (o, ṭ). On sound, Koṭīśvara is weak, as Watters and Lambrick say. The case for Koteshwar rests on position and the Siva temple only.
